title: Squared-Ratio Security for Nonce-Misuse nEHtM
summary: The nonce-respecting case has been analyzed, but extending the Squared-Ratio method to prove multi-user security for two-permutation nEHtM under nonce reuse remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the Squared-Ratio method can be extended to establish a multi-user security theorem for the two-permutation nEHtM MAC when nonces may be reused across queries, and develop the required combinatorial analysis despite its anticipated complexity.

scope.domain: Multi-user security analysis of the two-permutation nEHtM message authentication code in nonce-misuse settings.
assumptions: Nonces may be reused across queries.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the Squared-Ratio method to prove a multi-user security theorem for two-permutation nEHtM with nonce reuse and provide the necessary combinatorial analysis.

citations.label: Improved Multi-User Security Using the Squared-Ratio Method

progress.summary: Following an analysis of two-permutation nEHtM in the nonce-respecting setting, the authors state that a similar approach should work with nonce misuse. They leave the required combinatorial analysis unresolved and expect it to be very complex.
citation_labels: Yu Long Chen et al., Improved Multi-User Security Using the Squared-Ratio Method
